verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a GitHub Actions CI/CD guide for testing agents automatically on each change. It also offers a terminal CLI for managing agents, scenarios and runs, an SDK with sync and async clients, project-level API keys, a published OpenAPI spec, and scheduled cron jobs, which together support headless automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, plus details on non-interactive exit codes and pass/fail gating.
